Cookies & consent

Cookies & consent

Eurovision Games keeps cookies to the bare minimum: one strictly-necessary category that keeps the game working, and an analytics category that is off and currently unused — we run no analytics. No advertising, no cross-site tracking, no dark patterns.

PrivacyTermsCookiesAbout
What we useWhat we do NOT useChange your consentWhere data livesCookie consent banner
On this pageWhat we useWhat we do NOT useChange your consentWhere data livesCookie consent banner

What we use

Two categories: the strictly-necessary one, and an analytics category that is currently empty. "Necessary only" is the same number of clicks as "Accept all" — we don't bury the off switch.

CategoryPurposeDefault
Strictly necessaryKeeps you in your room — a Supabase authentication session (anonymous for players and hosts; email sign-in for site admins) plus your room code, player ID and the room password if one was set — remembers your language, sound and display preferences, and stores the consent choice itself.Always on — required for the game to work.
Analytics (none currently)None — we run no analytics today. If we ever add an analytics tool (e.g. Plausible), we will ask for your consent here first.Off until you opt in.

What we do NOT use

  • No advertising cookies. Eurovision Games doesn't run ads.
  • No social tracking pixels. No Meta Pixel, no LinkedIn Insight tag, no TikTok pixel.
  • No third-party retargeting. Nothing that follows you off the site.
  • No fingerprinting libraries. No device hashing or behavioural ID.

Change your consent

Open the preferences modal below or click the Cookies & Consent entry in the footer of any page. You can flip Analytics on or off without affecting the strictly-necessary category.

Open cookie preferences

Launches the preferences modal where you can revisit your choice. Your selection is remembered across visits on this device until cleared.

Where data lives

The strictly-necessary state lives in your browser's local storage and standard cookies. Apart from an anonymous sign-in session created when you open the game, nothing about you is sent until you create or join a room. Game state (room, players, predictions, scores) lives in our database while the room is active and is purged according to the retention policy in our Privacy Policy.

  • Browser storage — sign-in session, language, room code, player ID, room password (if set), sound and display preferences, consent choice.
  • Server (Supabase Postgres) — room and game data tied to a room ID, not to identifying data for guests.
  • Hosting (Vercel) — request logs retained 14 days for security and abuse prevention.

Cookie consent banner

On first visit you see a small banner at the bottom of the page with three buttons: Accept all, Necessary only (analytics off), and Manage preferences. "Necessary only" takes the same number of clicks as "Accept all" — we don't dark-pattern you into agreeing. The banner reappears if you clear browser storage or revoke your choice from this page.
